summary.zh: 周四费城半导体指数暴跌6.7%，创7月底以来新低，今早SOXX盘前小幅回升约0.2%，美光等存储股领涨，海力士隔夜涨近5%。超跌后有技术性反弹空间，但期货偏弱、油价高企和周末地缘风险会压制涨幅，预计小幅收涨。
summary.en: After Thursday's 6.7% plunge took the SOX to its lowest close since late July, SOXX is up about 0.2% pre-market, with memory names like Micron leading and SK Hynix up almost 5% overnight. An oversold bounce is likely, but softer index futures, high oil and weekend Iran risk should cap it, so I expect a modest gain.

factors.zh: 周四SOX暴跌6.72%，超跌后存在技术性反弹需求
factors.en: SOX fell 6.72% Thursday to its lowest since July 29, leaving it oversold

factors.zh: 存储股走强：海力士隔夜涨近5%，美光盘前涨约1.2%
factors.en: Memory leads: SK Hynix up almost 5% overnight, Micron about +1.2% pre-market

factors.zh: SOXX、SMH盘前仅小涨约0.2%，英伟达、阿斯麦盘前持平
factors.en: SOXX and SMH only about +0.2% pre-market; Nvidia and ASML flat

factors.zh: 标普期货跌约0.2%–0.5%，VIX升至20以上，避险情绪仍在
factors.en: S&P futures down about 0.2–0.5% and VIX above 20: risk appetite still weak

factors.zh: Meta资本开支担忧、泛林供应链受限的说法和油价约111美元、伊朗空袭传闻仍未消退
factors.en: Unresolved worries: Meta's AI spending, Lam Research's supply-constraint warning, oil near 11 and Iran strike reports

views.en: Sees the chip damage as technical, not fundamental: business strength is intact, and any further leg lower should be quick and a good buying opportunity.
views.zh: 认为芯片股的下跌是技术面压力而非基本面恶化，行业基本面依然强劲；即使再跌一段也会很快，是很好的买入机会。

views.en: Memory stocks bounced, but strategists are split; defensive sectors leading the market could mean more near-term pressure on semiconductors, and one strategist argues the KOSPI has peaked.
views.zh: 存储股反弹，但策略师看法分歧：防御板块领涨可能意味着芯片股短期仍有压力，另有策略师认为韩国股市（KOSPI）已经见顶。

views.en: Warned that component shortages will keep limiting chipmakers into 2027, but said it is nothing like the COVID-era crunch and expects the industry to catch up soon.
views.zh: 警告零部件供应紧张将限制芯片厂商到2027年，但表示远不及疫情时期的短缺，预计行业很快会赶上需求。

views.en: Pre-market report: US futures slightly lower and the AI trade could lose near-term momentum, even as Nvidia, AMD and Meta recover a little.
views.zh: 盘前报道：美股期货小幅走低，AI 交易短期可能失去动能，尽管英伟达、AMD 和 Meta 盘前略有回升。

views.en: Chips lead the pre-market rebound, but the leaders' weekly trends remain badly damaged, so a one-day bounce doesn't repair the chart.
views.zh: 芯片股领跑盘前反弹，但龙头股的周线趋势仍严重受损，一天的反弹修复不了走势。
